name: Seamstress
ability: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.
wakes: Every night, including the first, until the ability is used. The Seamstress may decline to choose. Once the ability is used, they are marked No ability and no longer woken.
interaction: Chooses: Either nothing, or any 2 players other than themself (alive or dead, Travellers allowed). Learns: Yes (nod) if the two players are the same alignment, no (shake) otherwise.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when choosing, the ability is still used up (No ability) and the Storyteller may give either answer. The engine offers the false answer as a misinformation option.

rulings.text: They may choose alive or dead players or even Travellers.
The question is whether the two share an alignment, not whether both are good: two evil players give yes.
A player whose character was changed (e.g. by the Pit-Hag into a good character) is compared on their current alignment.
Signalling no action does not use the ability. Choosing players uses it and removes the Seamstress from the night order.

test_scenarios.name: two good players give yes
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Seamstress, Bob Chef, Cara Empath, Dan Imp, Eve Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice chooses Bob and Cara.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns yes. Alice gets the No ability reminder and is not woken on later nights.

test_scenarios.name: two evil players give yes
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Seamstress, Bob Chef, Cara Empath, Dan Imp, Eve Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Dan and Eve.

test_scenarios.name: declining keeps the ability
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Seamstress, Bob Chef, Cara Empath, Dan Imp, Eve Baron.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice declines. Night 3: Alice chooses Bob and Dan.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 1: no information, Alice is still woken on night 2. Night 3: Alice learns no and the ability is used.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Seamstress still spends the ability
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Seamstress, Bob Chef, Cara Empath, Dan Imp, Eve Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Eve poisons Alice, then Alice chooses Bob and Dan.
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller is offered truthful no and misinformation yes and picks yes. Alice learns yes and gets No ability.

test_scenarios.name: Spy can register as good
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Seamstress, Bob Chef, Sam Spy, Dan Imp, Cara Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice chooses Bob and Sam; the Storyteller has Sam register as good.
